nom: The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + Beta Glucan Lightweight Gel Moisturizer

avis.texte: I had been using The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA as a dupe for Tatcha's Dewy Milk Moisturizer, as my day moisturizer. It worked well, but a skincare routine app said The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + Beta Glucan was a better match for me. First application I was unimpressed but i used the same amount as i used with previous creams. Then i read a review elsewhere advising you only need a PEA-sized amount otherwise it wouldn't absorb. This tip worked great! Imo this moisturizer also works better with my primer (Bare Minerals Prime Time Original). Another TiP i learned from that other review is to apply it to damp skin (i apply while my serum is still damp) instead of dry skin. This addresses people's claim that this moisturizer isn't hydrating. Doing this counteracts the fact that this moisturizer has a higher amount of humectants than occlusives. Again, i use this as a lightweight daycream so it still may not be moisturizing enough for others or as a nightcream.
May not be for everyone definately for a morning day mosturizor and go for more hydration for night routine.

Ive used quite a few products from the ordinary but this is one of my least favorite. I wanted an alternarive to their more heavy weight cream moisturizer that i use during the winter but this gel moisturizer did not work as well as i hoped. like other reviewers i felt it stung my face upon application and was very sticky after drying. i had to use another moisturizer on top of this one in order to avoid feeling dry and tight after usage.

avis.titre: Package isn't clear; icky feeling; doesn't absorb
avis.texte: The packaging isn't clear if you're purchasing in store. It does not say it is a GEL. It's pretty icky feeling applying and does not absorb as well as the original normal cream moisturizer. You can feel the sticky gel on your skin for a few hours after application.

I'm older and wrinkles run in the family. I was using the regular cream and it was ok but decided to switch to gel just to try it out. I use less, it's absorbed quickly and WOW my face looks less wrinkled. Oh yes, this is great stuff!
This moisturizer is very goopy, has a lube-like texture that surprised me. It's very liquid, kind of thick gel. Definitely for oily/combo skin, isn't hydrating enough for dry skin. It was fine.

avis.titre: I will not be buying this product again
avis.texte: I will not be repurchasing this product because it only came half way full which really upset me.This product also leaves my fingers and face extremely sticky.Personally I really don't think it even moisturizes me. Super dissatisfied with this product.

I have combo/sensitive skin. This stuff will sting quite badly if you have even the slightest skin irritation. Most times I didn't know my skin was irritated until I applied this, and it doesn't soothe at all. On good days it doesn't cause any stinging. It also does a very disappointing job of moisturizing. About 1-2 hours later my face will feel dry as if I put no moisturizer on if I use it as a standalone moisturizer. The only thing I like about it is the lightweight texture and that my skin isn't oily after use. It has some benefit and mild moosturizing but honestly I've used serums and hydrating toners that do a far better job alone than this product.
I've been using this for a year and I love it, moisturizes with no residue, mixes well with my other skin care items.. so I love it!

avis.titre: not used to the gel moisturizer
avis.texte: I picked this up thinking it was the lotion moisturizer. I dint really like the gel feeling on my skin but it does seem to work well and its not sticky afterwards and dries fine.

caused break outs is number 1 . 2nd off the texture is extremely odd. it doesnt just feel like a gel. its like aloe Vera kind of. it stays sticky and it doesnt feel hydrating at all . I'd pass. I am oily sensitive acne prone for reference
I have very dry skin. and this stuff is so amazing. I put it on and then its good all day! And no break out.
My skin feels soft and hydrated from using this moisturizer. I will be buying this product again
I do not like the greasy feel of normal moisturizer and this is super cooling and more hydrating.

this is a great moisturizer for summer, very light weight and cooling + leaves you looking glowyy. although, i do think that you need to have a steady routine with it. like a cleanser, toner, hydrating serum, thennn this product.

avis.titre: I wanted to like this SO bad
avis.texte: The ingredients looked great, and I really wanted a lightweight gel moisturizer as mine are all too heavy, and the texture of this initially felt great. However, it is SO drying. I put this on and then 10 minutes later my face is uncomfortably dry for the rest of the day. I can't use this on its own and need to layer another moisturizer on top of it.
This product feels like Iam putting a slimy hair product on my face. Nice feel after but you really have to wash your hands. I tried rubbing into my hands but had a ick feel.
Been looking for a good moisturizer for my combo skin. This one hit the mark. Dont have to use that much either and it keeps my face moisturized and oil under control.
This product made my skin feel really tight, if you don't want your skin feeling tight, I would not recommend.

After purchasing this moisturizer for a second time, its a hard no. I knew it was more for oily skin so I bought the squalene oil (which is amazing!!!) to help. However after 20 minutes the moisturizer was piling from my skin. I tried using it without my other skin care products but it wss still piling. I loved how it made my skin look and feel but I couldnt wear it at all.

This product has been the ULTIMATE GAME CHANGER for my skin. I have ALWAYS had rough, dry, sensitive skin on my cheeks, with barely a little oil in my T zone. I would also get sebaceous filaments in the T zone (probably because my skin is always super super dry). I have tried EVERYTHING to fix this. I thought I wasn't exfoliating enough, or perhaps I simply needed to add more oil products. Everything I tried only made it worse. Then I saw this product and thought maybe what I really needed was a different tactic. Maybe instead of oil based products, I should try doing the opposite. So I grabbed this. Within two weeks, the red areas of my skin lightened up - I have had red blotches my entire life so right away, I know somethings up. The sebaceous filaments stopped coming back as fast. My skin stopped being so rough in texture, turning soft and smooth. I stopped needing foundation. No breakouts, nothing. My skin is practically glowing. It's also bouncier???!! TOTAL GAME CHANGER! I gotta say though, I was surprised because it acts like a mask more than a moisturizer but I ultimately decided to trust the process. I apply it in the morning, and unlike the oils, it doesnt get absorbed by my skin, or simply get wiped off throughout the day. So if you're expecting it to feel and act like a typical cream, you might be confused when this simply seems to dry on your face. Like I said, it's more of a mask, locking in the moisture, keeping your skin hydrated all day long. I put it on in t

avis.titre: Dry skin people, hear me out
avis.texte: I have dry skin and I love this. I use it in place of an essence. I always follow with a heavier moisturizer. Nothing can beat the beta glucan amount found in this moisturizer.

avis.titre: Returning to exchange for Ordinary moisturizer
avis.texte: This is a GEL not a cream moisturizer. I missed that word on the package when I purchased it, haha. I have dry, sensitive, and cystic acne, definitely not for my skin. I have developed small sebaceous pimples all over my face over 1 & 1/2 weeks of use. HOWEVER, I do love the other moisturizers from The Ordinary.

avis.titre: i tried to get myself to like it
avis.texte: it feels like i put a purposefully drying product all over my face. my skin is tight, dry, and sticky for hours after using. i thought at first i was using too much, but it feels the same no matter how much or little i use.

My local store was out of Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA so I decided to try this one. Firstly, it's a gel and not a cream and that should have been my first clue. It applied it and while it went on smooth, that was not the ending result. My face feels like I'm wearing a mask of sorts and my skin does not feel hydrated at all. It feels like a dry cast and during these often dry fall/winter months this is NOT what I need for my skin. 0/10 would not recommend.
works well for my combo skin in the summer. makes my skin look healthy and hydrated and not oily which i love. the only con is that it is a little sticky on the face, but it's not super bothersome.

This is the best moisturizer for those with oily skin! I work in a hospital and this is the only moisturizer that has been able to keep my oil at bay to reduce breakouts without drying out my skin. It probably wouldn't work for those with normal and dry skin. I do have normal patches around my eyes so I use the Derma-E Skin Restore Advanced Peptides at night. Together, these are a dream team for those who want beautifully moisturized but not too oily skin that work in a hospital! For refernce, I have oily, acne-prone skin. I use Derma-E Acne Deep Pore Cleansing face cleanser, The Ordinary's niacinamide serum, and this moisturizer for day time plus the Derma-E moisturizer mentioned above at night time. With this combo, I have minimal acne only around where hospital masks, hairnets, etc touch.

avis.titre: not good for dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: terrible for dry skin-it made me feel even drier after application. pills under makeup-my lightweight foundation looked awful when paired with this moisturizer. It also made my face red and I was very aware of it, if that makes sense. I couldn't wait to wash it off. I gave it to my husband who has oily skin and he seems to be having better luck.

I live in a very humid place and dont want a thick moisturizer. This one is perfect! I notice a difference in one day that my skin feels softer and smoother and I think it really does repair the skin barrier quickly! My acne spots seem less red and the strength of my skin overall seems better!
the only complaint I would have is that it leaves a tight, dry feeling to your face
I didnt like this product it made my face burn and it had a sticky feel to it. Wouldn't recommend.

ive used this as my daily moisturizer for a coulple of years now. it was perfect. it gave my skin that perfect glow, lightweight (great for my oily/combination skin), first gel moisturizer i tried and instantly fell in love with it. i love testing out and trying new products but i ALWAYS came back to this moisturizer. unfortunately i recently bought some more as usual and its just not the same anymore :(. im not sure if the formula changed or what but its NOTHING like it use to be for me. it feels the same and looks the same but recently its been DRYING my skin out! and sometimes burns and tingles when i apply it. im super sad and now on the hunt for my new fave moisturizer!!!😭😭

I have oily skin and typically only use a hydrating essence in the morning. Upon first round of use of this product, the skin around my nose and mouth became painfully dry and flakey. I assumed it was an exfoliating product I was using had burned my skin. I had to limit my product usage for over 2 weeks to heal the skin. Within minutes of my second usage of this product, after my skin had healed, it became obvious what the culprit is. Immeditately rinsed off my face and put moisturizing, healing products on. The skin is still red and dry. Absolutely horrible. Never had this issue with an moisturizer before.

For a few years I have been using the Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA but when I saw this product, I thought I will try since I have oily skin. Unfortunately, it didn't work for my skin at all, made it feel and, most importantly, look very dry. It doesn't target dryness, it causes it.

avis.titre: love it but have some thoughts
avis.texte: i have acne prone oily skin and i was soo happy when i found this moisturizer as its fungal acne and acne safe, and unscented. i really like how cooling this moisturizer is and how its not greasy, but i will say that i wouldnt recommend to people who dont have oily skin. even though i have oily skin, in the winter it was sometimes a bit drying and left my face feeling tight, so i wouldn't recommend if you have normal skin and definitely not if you have dry skin. i think its great for the summer, and i recommend using a generous amount so your skin gets enough hydration.

I got this moisturizer to replace a different The Ordinary moisturizer. I wanted to try it because it had great reviews and its been a couple weeks of usage and i have never tried a more drying product period. It feels nice for the first three minutes but after that my skin dries to the point where i can feel every inch if my face move if i try to talk or smile. I hate it so much.

looking for some help here because I don't understand why does it foam on my skin when I put it on? just started using this product and not sure if it suits my skin well. my skin feels dry and remains sticky after applying the product for 10 minutes or so.
I love how light this moisturizer is! It doesn't feel heavy on your skin. It's like a glass of water for your face. No smell so that is nice too. Good sized bottle too.

i have very oily skin so i thought i would love this moisturizer, but it is so so sooo sticky. and also once it is almost completely rubbed in, it kind of tugs on my skin. when i wake up, my skin felt dry, not hydrated. i think it felt dry because it is sticky. i hope they reformulate this one day

Definitely feel this should be targeted towards oily or combo skin. I've been searching for a gel moisturizer that doesn't evaporate 30 seconds after applying yet feels moisturizing. Absolutely love this moisturizer, something in the formula also gives it some silkiness which I haven't seen in other moisturizers. Love love love, absolutely recommend
The sample made me buy the entire ordinary set for my hormonal acne and I haven't had a major break out in days! This has been an ongoing struggle for the last 2 years

I have super-oily skin and I struggle with acne - this is by far the best moisturizer I've ever used. It feels very lightweight and keeps my skin fairly oil-free for the entire day. My skin has also become much clearer since I've started using it! I'm super impressed!

First few days, it was great. My skin felt hydrated but not greasy. Unfortunately, I realized it was causing redness & irritation. So disappointed because I really wanted to love it. For some this could be great. Sadly, it wasn't for me.
The texture is like a transparent gel, it's so lightweight, perfect for oily skin and perfect for makeup days. It's somehow light but moisturizing at the sane time

I bought this recently and I've always struggled with oily moisturisers being catered to normal or dry skin and I have combination. So I thought I'd try this and it's amazing! It's actually reduced the oil on my T Zone and I don't get any acne which I got from other brand cream moisturisers. Amazing!

I have oily, acne-prone skin that is also dehydrated and becomes dull and congested very easily. I have looked for decades for a gel moisturizer like this that does not contain silicones/dimethicone or fragrance, which also break me out. This is it! I never want to be without it, please never discontinue it! Not only does it provide the perfect amount of moisture for me, the beta glucan calms breakouts and redness. Truly the best ever.

Bought this trying out new moisturizers as my old one was discontinued. And THANK GOD I chose this. It doesnt feel oily at all, nor does it leave any film or stickyness. It comes as a clear gel but it almost melts into the water I spray on my face for when I moisturize. I was worried about it having perfume and my skin reacting to it, but it doesnt have a strong smell and it smells clean, and like it has some SPF in there but I could be wrong. I was also worried about the amount of product since you can't seem to find anything that lasts anymore but it has plenty of product, plus I dont seem to need as much as other products, so it works out. This is definitely my new go-to moisturizer, my skin looks more clear and healthy and my redness has even gone down a bit. 10/10, 5 stars, would recommend.

avis.titre: I feel protected. I feel clean. I feel hydrated.
avis.texte: My skin type is combination, acne-prone (even on my normal/dry cheeks) and sensitive. This moisturizer is IDEAL for me. The NMF+HA has a great reputation, yet I still got some issues with it : my skin would be a little greasy on the short term; I could eventually get breakouts. I would recommend this gel moisturizer (NMF+Beta Glucan), if you need something truly lightweight. The NMF+BG is easily spread and quickly absorbed. In fact, it penetrates so well that your skin is ''dry'' just after a few minutes. It seals perfectly the other products of my routine. Moreover, it does leave somewhat of a film on the skin. Personally, I love it; it almost feels like a second skin barrier. I feel protected. I feel clean. I feel hydrated. I love this product so much that I just bought a second tube; my first one lasted about three months. I use it AM and PM. It is hard to find products that complement the polar opposites of my combination skin. This moisturizer is gentle and versatile. I hold the NMF+BG in high esteem.

this is really good if you have normal to oily skin. i have dry skin and. i did not feel that it was enough for me. it leaves a sticky residue on the skin, almost as if it's a mask you left on for too long if that makes sense

I'm using it right now and it's amazing for my oily sensitive skin with acne and rosacea. I want to buy it again but I can't find ceramides in the list of ingredients, but they still in the description of the product. Does this gel contain ceramides?
it is very hydrating and lightweight but my only problem is that it is sticky, if they fixed that it would be perfect

avis.titre: A great product by The Ordinary as usual
avis.texte: Loved the way it made my skin feel after using it. Did not have a distinct scent which I am completely okay with as some facial products have overpowering smells.

I was using the Natural Moisturising Factors + HA moisturiser but found it quite heavy for day time use. I'm 43 and have oily skin and large pores, but also prone to facial dermatitis. This moisturiser soaks in immediately and my skin glows. Even after a few hours my skin doesn't become oily. Just be careful not to use too much as it can settle on your skin like a mask and peel off when you rub your face.

I usually don't like gel-like products, but I absolutely love this moisturiser from The Ordinary. I have been using it for a few weeks now and it has not broken me out in pimples or acne which is fantastic. It leaves a glowy finish to your skin, but does not feel greasy, it almost feels matte when you touch your skin. I would say it's ideal for vacations to sunny places, for summer and for those who get sweaty or oily skin during the day as it's not too thick.

i have oily, sensitive acne prone skin and i was so happy when i found this product as its acne and fungal acne safe. i will say it maybe a tiny bit too drying in the winter (if you live in a cold country), but in the summer this will be amazing. it didnt break me out, and i love how cooling it feels on my skin. its also the first moisturizer ive used that doesnt make my sensitive skin bright red the first hour after applying. i will say this moisturiser is just for oily skin and normal to oily skin, if you are leaning towards the dry skin type i wouldn't recommend this.
I use this often but in conjunction with the B oil or HA moisturizer. Alone it just isn't enough in a dry winter. My skin feels tight and very thirsty after use. it's texture is nice however

I have combination skin (forehead can get a bit oily but i sometimes get eczema and dry patches around my nose and mouth) so because it said it targets dryness I gave it a shot - it didn't feel like it hydrated my skin at all and after application I was still bothered by the tight feeling I get after washing my face. It felt like it just put a layer over the dry parts of my face without adding anything to them. I'm sure this is a good product and would work well for someone with oily skin but I would really avoid if you need any hydration from your moisturiser. I'm switching back to the original natural moisturising factors having not used much of this.
It feels great going on, but after a few minutes your skin feels super dry, tight, slightly burning and majorly irritated! It feels like it actually sucks all the moisture out of your face

I think this faded 15+ year old scars…?!? It's the only new product I've used, and the only thing that I apply to my neck and upper chest. I've had these 2 small keloid scars forever, and tried a variety of both cheap and expensive topical scar treatments. None worked, although silicon tape seemed to soften them a bit years ago. Anyway, I'd given up on trying stuff and didn't really feel very self conscious about them anyway. I just tried this moisturizer because it was new and my sensitive, combo skin typically does fine with the Ordinary products. It's super light and usually not moisturizing enough solo on my face, but it's the perfect amount for my neck and chest…anyway, I wasn't even thinking about treating scars I just slapped this on AM/PM whenever I remembered or felt like it. And then one day I randomly noticed the faded scarring! No idea if it will work for anyone else, but certainly worth a shot for the price. The photos have way different lighting, but they're both me & unfiltered. I initially took one wanting to track size and make sure they weren't growing or negatively changing.

I have acne prone skin and ceremide typically causes break out. This one caused break out as well. I am disappointed they included ceremide to several new products. I can't use hyaluronic acid 2% anymore.

i bought this in december, and it ran out this week,ofcourse i had to repurchase. this moisturiser is one of the best i've used, i love the texture and it's lightweight, leaves a little glow on the skin and keeps it hydrated thru out the day.

avis.titre: Superb hydration even for winter mature skin
avis.texte: I got this for the summer but am still using this in winter. It's amazingly hydrating for my 60+ skin and keeps skin soft all day. Only when it's really cold outside do I add a drop oil. Such a great buy compared with the ceramide NMF which can produce a bit of an oil slick with some squalane based serums.
This product caused a terrible allergic reaction, my eyes are swollen and blstered and my face is red and sore.

Now feeling pretty annoyed as I need to go buy another moisturiser. I do not have naturally dry skin but this has sucked the life out of my face. It is so dry after applying it, and after 2 weeks my skin is kinda sore.
I normally have oily skin with some dry patches and this really helped give me an even texture. I love this for everyday use and my skin drank it up morning and night.
Added this to my daily/nightly skin care routine and I am obsessed! I will forever keep this as a staple item. Perfect for those tricky dry spots!

This product has transformed my skin in just 1 month. I had a very oily T-zone with breakouts and rough looking texture. This product has helped fix the t-zone, even my skin texture, and smoothed and soothed my combo skin. Highly recommend!
This made my face so soft. It did not leave a weird residue like some moisturizers I have used in the past. This rubs in so easy as well. Highly recommend

Unfortunately this moisturizer broke me out. I wanted to like it and thought it'd work better than the regular moisturizer which also broke me out. Sadly not the case. I'll skill all TO moisturizers and continue to splurge on better quality products like Vivier.

Other Ordinary moisturizers make my skin greasy and I get little breakouts from them. They also made my face sweat excessively. This is so great for my skin!!! It leaves me feeling so smooth and moisturized without any weird buildup or greasiness. I love it

I bought this moisturizer awhile back and use it once in a while.. but just today i was out of my leave-in hair serum… so.. I slapped on a quarter sized bit of this on my Very Dry hair and wow its so soft and short and healthy 👀 I am impressed with the versatility here ill come back soon with a pic

Definitely a great cream! I have very sensitive skin and this product did not disappoint! Highly recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin. Keeps skin Moisturize￼d for a long time without having to reapply.

Every other moisturiser I've used is too heavy to use during the day - even mild moisturisers usually just get greasy on my skin. And/or they start to pill after sweating. This product sinks in beautifully and leaves my skin plump and hydrated but perfectly clean and dry. As it's a gel, I thought it might be sticky but it's not at all. It's perfect for summer, especially under a sunscreen or after using face masks. It also works great for sealing in eye treatments. I still plan to use my more typical moisturiser (The Ordinary with moisturising factors + HA) in the evenings, but I'm so glad I've found this!
I did not like this product it made my face burn I did not use it more than once. I would not recommend this product to anyone if you have sensitive skin.
Not sticky at all. Really like it because usually the moisturizing product leaves on skin a sticky sensation but not with this one, also absorbs quick

This is a great moisturiser, on its own it's quite light but it emulsifies/mixes with any oil perfectly, so during the cold winter months I've taken to mixing it with two or so drops of rose hip seed oil, highly recommend. The ingredients are great, and beta glucan is interesting, but I suspect the actual star of this product is PPG-24-Glycereth-24.

I totally forgot about posting this and I'm so shocked, this was a great simple moisturizer that actually hydrated my sensitive dry skin, I didn't break out, it was great for makeup prepping, if that's something you'd use it for. I loved it, sometimes the simple ones work the best!

My skin is extremely sensitive and acne prone, I got the acne set which included this moisturizer... it irritated my skin so bad it felt BURNT, after reading the reviews I realized I wasn't the only one.

I have realky bad acne and my skin breaks out at the drop of a dime. This moisturizer is quite lirerally PERFECT. It is a geo formula so it absorbs really fast. It pairs beautifully with my other ordinary products- and for my makeup girlies, it works wonderfully under makeup! 10/10!

avis.titre: The best moisturizer I have ever used!
avis.texte: The perfect amount of moisture. Absorbs nicely. Doesn't clog pores. Is perfect under makeup. Excellent product!
This is one of the best products I have use. My daughter even tried and love it.. I will be buying the product again. It makes your skin feel soft vet soft

avis.titre: Great summer moisturizer for normal/dry skin
avis.texte: I have dry skin in the winter/fall months and normal (but still leaning towards dry) skin in the spring/summer months. I bought this in the transition between spring and summer when I noticed my skin often felt a bit sore and dry from the sudden change of season. I live in Canada and spent a lot of time outdoors as soon as the sun started shining and temperatures rose. The moisturizer is clear and is similar in texture to a hair gel just without any stickiness. It feels cool and soothing on the skin and soaks in pretty much right away leaving no trace behind. Also basically no scent besides a tiny hint of like generic lotion smell. As someone with dry skin, I prefer a bit of grease in a moisturizer for that soft glow on the skin so I was a little sad that it disappeared, but it was great for those extra hot days where a heavy moisturizer would just be too much. In terms of how moisturized/hydrated my skin felt throughout the day and after about 4 months of using it almost every day - I think that it's just okay. Not the amount of hydration where my skin looked noticeably plump or extra healthy, but just enough that it wasn't cracked, or flaky and felt smooth. Overall I don't think I'll be repurchasing just because it didn't quite give me enough juice to make my skin extra happy. It was just kinda meh. That being said, I can see it being incredible for post-sunburn care (and will be taking it with me to Cuba just in case) or if you have oily skin to use as a daily moisturizer.

I really like this moisturiser. I have combo skin, with some parts being oilier and others fairly balanced. My skin is very prone to CCs and becoming clogged. I was looking for a good, basic moisturiser (without all the fancy bells and whistles) to apply over my serums. A lot of moisturisers I've tried have caused CCs, so I was interested to try this gel moisturiser. I'm glad I did because this moisturiser is great. Doesn't clog my skin at all, it's not oily (there's no oils in it), it's lightweight and it hydrates nicely - especially in conjunction with my other skincare items. This is all I was looking for in a moisturiser. It is a little tacky on the skin, but this feeling fades after about 10-15 minutes. I will definitely continue to use a repurchase :)
It looks, feels and smells like hand sanitizer going on and it dries my face out too.

I decided to try this moisturizer after being hooked on the OG ordinary product, and I love this one even more for a day time product! It leaves a matte finish while still being hydrating, and is great for oily/combo skin! I am going to stock up!!
This product gave me a rash that i still have in two weeks no moisturizer my face was dryer i love ordinary but thid is not it
This product gave me a rash that i still have in two weeks no moisturizer my face was dryer i love ordinary but thid is not it

I think this is the first moisturizer I've had that actually makes my skin feel moisturized. Great price and the bottle is bigger than I expected. My skin looks SO clear after one use of this. I have combo skin btw

This moisturizer is the best for my oily skin. It absorbs fast and leaves no shiny or greasiness behind. I can put it on in to morning and my face still looks matte by end of the day. Wouldn't recommend for normal to dry skin. It doesn't feel super moisturizing like a typical mositurizer, but oily skin can tolerate it.

Guys, you really hit the jackpot with this one. I'm a 27yo man with oily skin and let me tell you… this works wonders. I've had a big trouble so far trying to find the right finisher which will NOT make me sweat my brains out… Everything I've used so far turns to water after 5 min of being applied to my face. This is The Chosen Moisturiser, I swear - perfect finish, non-oily and greasy, you can feel like there is something on there, but your skin is not glowing like the 4th of July sky. Thank you immensely for this!
Perfect for all ages even pre teens. Non greasy, doesn't clog pores, no smell, easy to use, great moisturizer. Great packaging, easy to apply..
Does not moisturize at all, makes my skin irritated and red, leave a sticky layer that never dries... garbage !!
It is a very watery moisturizer and lightweight with no smell. Good for summer but not great if you're looking for a heavier moisturizer for the winter

Was having a real problem with combination skin when someone recommended this and wow! Saw a real difference after two weeks of use and now I'm hooked. Works well as an alternative to makeup primer. Doesn't make my skin oily or leave it with dry patches. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Worst moisturizer I have ever used
avis.texte: My skin did not like this moisturizer at all. I made the skin on my face red, incredibly dry and flakey after about three times of use. I would not recommend it.

I used the natural moisturizing factors +HA and man let me tell you, I started to sweat on my forehead, nose, lips and chin. My skin looked so shiny I swear you could see reflections in them. Emailed customer care and explained my concerns. The recommended Natural Moisturizing Factors + Beta Glucan. I'm impressed so far and I love that my face isn't as oily as the HA. however, I do feel like my skin is slightly sticky but it doesn't bother me much. Rather feel sticky clean then oily and dirty.
This didn't work well for me. Dries my face and broke my skin out. The design is nice but not worth the hype. Not something I'd buy on my own. Smell was ok

avis.titre: As if nothing was done to my face
avis.texte: I bought this product over the summer and wish I hadn't. I really wanted to like this moisturizer, but it does absolutely nothing for my skin. It leaves it feeling dehydrated and dull - really disappointed.

avis.titre: Does not irritate my skin, seals in serums!
avis.texte: Its not that moisturizing on its own but its real power is that it "seals" in the serums I use and makes my skin smooth and no longer tacky. Im obsessed. A lot of moisturizers clog my pores too, but not this one!

avis.titre: Seemed like a good moisturizer at first
avis.texte: This seemed like a good moisturizer upon looking at the ingredients. I have acne-prone combination skin, which means most creams are too heavy for me but I also get dry patches on certain parts of my face. I was surprised that this gel actually moisturized my skin pretty well. It feels tacky upon application but it dries down nicely and it made my skin feel plump and soft after absorbing. Unfortunately I've noticed that it breaks my face out in whiteheads, so I had to stop using it.

I am 60 years old and still have acne-prone skin. I've never needed to use facial moisturizer, but I recently started using Retin-A Micro, which needs a moisturizer to combat the resulting dryness. This one sounded promising, and it has delivered on its promise. At night, I use the Retin-A Micro and let it soak in for about 10 minutes. I then use this product. The gel is so light and it just melts into my skin, making my skin feel soft, but in no way greasy. In the morning, I use it after The Ordinary Niacinamide. It's just perfect for my skin.

I have combination skin, with a lot of closed comedones, so i use retinal and a BHA face wash that help me a lot, but make my skin dehydrated (which is a problem that I have anyway, those products just make it a bit worse). I bought this cream for the summer, because I wanted something light to use at the end of my routine, but this is useless, it's like not putting anything on. A lot of creams break me out, this one didn't but also leaves my skin completely dehydrated, as if i didn't use it at all. Also i don't have a lot of irritation, but this product doesn't help at all with the little that i have. I prefer the NMF + HA cream, even though it does break me out sometimes as it is too heavy for my skin, since it is prone to clogged pores.
Fantastic product from The Ordinary with the simplistic, wholesome, quality we've come to expect from the brand. Great lightweight morning moisturizer to prepare your skin for the day!
Keeps my skin super hydrated but doesn't leave it shiny or oily. I can feel the moisture absorb and leaves my skin feeling fresh. Definitely recommend this formula.

This is amazing for my sensitive, acne-prone skin. I didn't love it at first because it's a clear serum moisturizer that dries a bit sticky at first, but it soaks in quickly and my skin is bright, plump, moisturized, and looks and feels fantastic!

avis.titre: Perfect for rosacea and oily skin
avis.texte: Using a sample of this these 2 days and i can tell you this is what i was looking for! The phytoceramide moisturiser is very heavy on my skin and makes it very red because its very heavy and thick for my skin.this formula makes me not skip the last step anymore and makes the skin matt but moisturiesed and smooth
I suffer from rosacea and very dry skin. This moisturizer helped improve my skins texture and really hydrated my skin. It bas no scent, which I prefer.

avis.titre: So mouisturing does everything it says !
avis.texte: I bought this 2 weeks ago and it's helped with my acne prone skin I experience less breakouts since using this. Best skincare product I ever purchased and will always be buying again. Leaves my skin feeling amazing and plump .
I recieved this product and I was excited to try it. At first once I applied it to my face it's felt really sticky and not a good feeling to me,but it does work wonders.i had to trust the process

My skin for the past several years has been a nightmare. Ive been dealing with hormona acne and my skin has been so sensitive, dry and acne prone. Before i found this product i was using neutrogena hydroboost or clinique moisture surge and they worked but were very expensive and i didnt get enough product. I kid you not i will never buy another moisturizer again. This product really releived the redness in my skin and its feel so healthy for the first time in so many years.
Honestly I didn't love this product as much as I was hoping that I would. After using it, I found that it left my skin feeling tacky, which I didn't love

Picked this up on a whim and wow! I have dry acne prone skin, its hard to find moisturizers that dont break me out. This not only feels amazing, but looks amazing. My skin looks so much brighter and plump. Initially it does dry down tacky, but after some time it absorbs nicely and my skin looks so plump. I use in combination with other ordinary products. I recommend using only on a clean face, if you put it on in the morning just be sure to wash your face first and use as the last step in your routine.

I love this product was trying to find a new moisturizer, and Gel like moisturizers tend to be better on my skin compared to regular moisturizers. Those ones tend to make my skin more oily. I have normal to dry skin and most of winter my skin is SUPER dry and so far this has been great and has help my acne!

avis.titre: Perfect moisturiser if you like light textures
avis.texte: It's hard to find moisturisers that have a light gel texture but also include hydrating, barrier-supporting ingredients like ceramides and amino acids. This does both, and the beta-glucan is also perfect for my slightly sensitive skin. Given that I can't handle heavy, clogging creams, this is an absolute game changer. Brilliant product.

avis.titre: It's really nice, but not hydrating enough for dry skin
avis.texte: It's really nice, but not hydrating enough for dry skin. I have very dry skin and this doesn't quite help. But, it would be a great moisturizer for someone who doesn't need extra moisture.

I have normal skin on the oilier side and this is not hydrating enough even for me. It could work as a daytime moisturiser but I still prefer the HA moisturizer that they do - this one leaves me a bit tight.

I accidentally bought this moisturizer instead of the normal one but i wasnt mad about it at all!! when you first put this on it makes your skin feel so cold if that makes any sense. it also leaves it reslly soft and a little sticky its giving primer lowkeyyy 😩😩👀👀 but i do love this moisturizer.. i use it when as part of my skin prep before my makeup and my base looks amazing!! i also use it at night after washing my face or taking a shower it just feels super refreshing.. i have super oily skin btw
Since I have oily skin, I have been looking for a light moisturizer that keeps my skin hydrated, but controlling the oiliness. This product works beautifully!

I had the OG of The Ordinary Natural Moisturizer and loved that one! Once I found out I got this one in the mail I gave my old one to my bf and started using this one right away! Definitely will be buying more!!
